description: Percentage of all City Buildings eligible for an ENERGY STAR score with a score greater than or equal to 75 is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. The EPA Energy Star Portfolio Manager is a nationally utilized online tool to measure and track energy and water consumption, as well as greenhouse gas emissions. The score, which ranges from 1 to 100 indicates the energy efficiency of a particular building. Coverage: Austin. The portal files it under the category City Infrastructure. The table has 15 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. The portal shows 2022-09-15 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
